definitions.explanation: A large, reddish-brown, tree-dwelling great ape native to the rainforests of Borneo and Sumatra, with long arms and high intelligence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧オランウータン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw an orangutan at the zoo.
Orangutans live up in the trees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{森林|しんりん}→森林：01441_shinrin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、オランウータン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶滅|ぜつめつ}→絶滅：03756_zetsumetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Because of deforestation, orangutans are in danger of extinction.

notes:
Loanword for the orangutan, one of the great apes (⟦{類人猿|るいじんえん}→類人猿：18454_ruijinen⟧). The name comes from Malay for 'person of the forest'.
